_: Combat (Stage 4; DESIGN.md 'Combat, pacing and forecasting'). One system for wild and party creatures. levels: by level (baby, young, adult, legend): hp, the health it has; dps, its power budget (damage a second, the same for every attack of that level, so no species is stronger for its level: equal power budget). attacks: each is data. delivery: melee (a hit within range), shot (a projectile flying at speed m/s, dodgeable, hitting the first enemy within its radius), or quake (everything of the other side within radius round the attacker: the legends' slow, heavy signature move). windup: seconds it telegraphs before it lands or flies; cooldown: seconds from one to the next; damage is dps times cooldown; range: metres it attacks from; modifier: none, knockback (pushes the target knockback metres) or slow (the target moves at slowMult for slowTime seconds; slows don't stack: a new one only renews it). Babies don't attack; the young have one attack, adults a stronger one with a modifier, legends the signature. ranged: the species that shoot (the rest fight in melee). Melee attacks wind up and lunge lunge metres at where they aimed (step aside to dodge); shots fly at where they aimed (dodgeable). bySpecies: a species' own attacks by level, overriding byLevel. kite: species that keep their distance as part of their attack (Ed, 2026-10-04), holding between near and far of their attack's range from their target, backing off or closing in (the raven, with long-range shots). Babies are never attacked by anything, on either side (Ed, 2026-10-04). temperament: how a species' babies take to the witch close by (tuning notice): curious ones come up to her, skittish ones keep off; the rest just turn to look.
